title: asreml
text: ASReml-R is a commercial package from VSN International (VSNi) for fitting linear mixed models with residual maximum likelihood (REML). wgaim and asremlPlus both build on it.

title: asremlPlus
text:
Helps automate choosing which terms to include in mixed models fitted with asreml, following the hierarchy (marginality) principle. It can also fit and compare two-dimensional spatial models, and keeps a history of the sequence of models fitted. It also computes and plots functions, contrasts and differences of predictions from any model-fitting function.
Author: Chris Brien

title: ASMap
text:
Accurate and speedy linkage map construction, manipulation and diagnosis for Doubled Haploid, Backcross and Recombinant Inbred R/qtl objects. Map clustering and optimal marker ordering use MSTmap (Wu et al., 2008).
Authors: Julian Taylor, David Butler

title: Handbook
text:
Pick a package to see where its documentation lives, how to install it, and how to cite it.


01

wgaim
Whole genome average interval mapping for QTL detection and estimation using ASReml-R.



02

ASMap
Fast linkage map construction and diagnosis using the MSTmap algorithm. Includes the vignette and the paper in the Journal of Statistical Software.



03

asreml
ASReml-R from VSNi: linear mixed models fitted by REML. Commercial and licensed.



04

asremlPlus
Augments ASReml-R with model selection, spatial model fitting and exploration of prediction differences.



05

dae
Functions for the design and ANOVA of experiments, including randomisation and assessment of designs.

title: wgaim
text:
A computationally efficient whole genome approach to detecting and estimating significant QTL in linkage maps, using the linear mixed modelling functionality of ASReml-R.
Authors: Julian Taylor, Ari Verbyla

title: dae
text:
Covers data, factor manipulation, design, ANOVA, matrix, projector and canonical efficiency functions. The design functions randomise and assess designs. The ANOVA functions extract information from aov fits that use Error().
